terbaru.judul: The Effects of Interaction Functions Between Two Cellular Automata
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper presents two interacting cellular automata (CA) as an abstract model to address the effects of complex interactions between two individual entities embedded within a larger system.

terbaru.judul: Open Questions in Creating Safe Open-ended AI: Tensions Between Control and Creativity
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes that open-ended evolution and artificial life have much to contribute towards the understanding of open-ended AI, focusing here in particular on the safety of open-ended search.

terbaru.judul: The Importance of Open-Endedness (for the Sake of Open-Endedness)
terbaru.pelajaran: A paper in the recent Artificial Life journal special issue on open-ended evolution (OEE) presents a simple evolving computational system that, it is claimed, satisfies all proposed requirements for OEE (Hintze, 2019).

terbaru.judul: Conditions for Open-Ended Evolution in Immigration Games
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we present evidence that Turing-completeness is a sufficient condition on the rules of Immigration Games, but not a necessary condition.
In this paper we propose an approach for measuring growth of complexity of emerging patterns in complex systems such as cellular automata.

terbaru.judul: An Overview of Open-Ended Evolution: Editorial Introduction to the Open-Ended Evolution II Special Issue
terbaru.pelajaran: We present a simplified categorization of OEE and summarize progress in the field as represented by the articles in this special issue.

terbaru.judul: Open-ended Evolution and a Mechanism of Novelties in Web Services
terbaru.pelajaran: Analogous to living ecosystems in nature, web services form an artificial ecosystem consisting of many tags and their associated media, such as photographs, movies, and web pages created by human users.

terbaru.judul: How to Make Swarms Open-Ended? Evolving Collective Intelligence Through a Constricted Exploration of Adjacent Possibles
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose an approach of open-ended evolution via the simulation of swarm dynamics.

terbaru.judul: Engineered Self-Organization for Resilient Robot Self-Assembly with Minimal Surprise
terbaru.pelajaran: We study self-assembly to increase the scenario's complexity for our minimal surprise approach and, at the same time, limit the complexity of our simulations to a grid world to manage the feasibility of this approach.

terbaru.judul: Conditions for Major Transitions in Biological and Cultural Evolution
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a set of conditions for open-ended evolution.
